The single-card column shows baseline latency; each multi-card cell shows **E2E latency in seconds and speedup over that single-card baseline**.
fc1046c19505dcc6: †T: text-encoder Offload only; †L: DiT/text layer Offload. Unmarked cells have no runtime Offload.
